sn22.3:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā MahāKaccāno Avantīsu viharati kuraraghare pavatte pabbate || || 2
sn22.3:1.3: Atha kho Hāliddikāni gahapati yenāyasmā MahāKaccāno tenupasaṅkami || Upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantam Mahā-Kaccānam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisidi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Hāliddikāni gahapati āyasmantam Mahā-Kaccānam etad avoca || ||
sn22.3:1.4: Vuttam idam bhante Bhagavatā Aṭṭhakavaggike Māgandiya-pañhe || ||

sn22.3:5.2: Rupadhātuyā kho gahapati yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā ye upāyupādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā || te Tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā || ||
sn22.3:5.7: Viññāṇadhātuyā kho gahapati yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi- anuppādadhammā || || Tasmā Tathāgato anokasārīti vuccati || || 14 Evaṃ kho gahapati anokasārī hoti || || 15 Kathaṃ ca gahapati niketasārī hoti || || Rūpanimittaniketasāravinibandhā kho gahapati niketasārī ti vuccati || || Saddanimitta || la || Gandhanimitta || Rasanimitta || Phoṭṭhabbanimitta || Dhammanimittaniketasāravinibandhā kho gahapati niketasārī ti vuccati || || 16 Kathaṃ ca gahapati aniketasārī hoti || || Rūpanimittaniketasāravinibandhā kho gahapati Tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā || ||
sn22.3:8.1: Kathaṃ ca gahapati gāme santhavajāto hoti ||

sn22.3:8.3: Evaṃ kho gahapati gāme santhavajāto hoti || || 19
sn22.3:9.1: Kathaṃ ca gahapati gāme na santhavajāto hoti || ||
sn22.3:9.2: Idha gahapati bhikkhu gihīhi asaṃsaṭṭho viharati || na sahanandī na sahasokī na sukhitesu sukhito na dukkhitesu dukkhito uppannesu kiccakaraṇīyesu na attanā tesu yogam āpajjati || ||
sn22.3:9.3: Evam kho gahapati gāme na santhavajāto ti || || 20 Kathaṃ
sn22.3:10.2: Idha gahapati ekacco kāmesu avigatarāgo hoti avigatachando avigatapemo avigatapipāso avigatapariḷāho avigatataṇho || ||

sn22.3:14.2: Idha gahapati ekacco evarūpiṃ kathaṃ kattā hoti || ||
sn22.3:14.3: Na tvaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayam ājānāsi aham imaṃ dhammavinayam ājānāmi kiṃ tvaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ājānissasi || micchāpaṭipanno tvam asi aham asmi sammāpaṭipanno || pure vacanīyam pacchā avaca pacchā vacanīyaṃ pure avaca || sahitam me asahitan te adhiciṇṇan te viparāvattam || āropito te vādo caravādappamokkhāya niggahīto si nibbeṭhehi vā sace pahosīti || ||
sn22.3:14.4: Evaṃ kho gahapati kathaṃ viggayha janena kattā hoti || || 25
sn22.3:15.1: Kathaṃ ca gahapati kathaṃ na viggayha janena kattā hoti ||
sn22.3:15.2: Idha gahapati bhikkhu na evarūpiṃ kathaṃ kattā hoti || ||
sn22.3:15.3: Na tvam imaṃ dhammavinayam ajānāsi || la || nibbeṭhehi vā sace pahosī ti || ||
sn22.3:15.4: Evam kho gahapati kathaṃ na viggayha janena kattā hoti || || 26
